paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: Mathematical problems across educational levels. We curate and categorize problems by difficulty and subject area.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of topics or subjects categorized by their educational level and percentage. There are twelve distinct slices in the chart. Each slice includes a percentage label outside it, providing clear information about the proportions.
